title: 11-Day Athens & Egypt Nile Cruise Journey
metaTitle: Athens & Nile Cruise | 11-Day Greece Egypt Tour
metaDescription: Travel from Athens to Cairo, Aswan and Luxor on an 11-day journey combining Classical Greece, the Pyramids and a memorable cruise along the Nile.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 11-Day Greece & Egypt Tour combines Athens and Mykonos with a Nile journey through Upper Egypt. Begin in Athens before continuing to Mykonos, then fly to Cairo for the Egyptian portion of the itinerary. After exploring Cairo’s major historical sites, travel south to Aswan for a three-night full-board cruise toward Luxor, with guided visits to important temples and monuments along the river.
The escorted itinerary operates from April to October and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, full-board cruise meals, professional local guides, guided-tour entrance fees, airport transfers and two domestic flights. The route adds a Nile Cruise and Upper Egypt to the Greece–Cairo combination, creating a clear distinction from shorter Athens–Cairo programs.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the National Library. Visit the Presidential Mansion to watch the Evzones Guards, then continue to the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Saronic Island Cruise
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Port of Piraeus for a full-day cruise to the beautiful Saronic Islands. Sail to Hydra, known for its charming harbor and traditional stone houses, then continue to Poros and Aegina. Enjoy free time on each island for walking, shopping, swimming, or relaxing at local cafés. Lunch will be served onboard during the cruise. Return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Delphi Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Depart for a full-day excursion to Delphi, one of the most important archaeological and spiritual sites of ancient Greece. Drive through the scenic countryside passing Thebes, Livadeia, and the charming mountain village of Arachova. Upon arrival, visit the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Treasury of the Athenians, the famous Temple of Apollo, and the impressive Delphi Archaeological Museum, home to many important ancient artifacts. After the tour, return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out and transfer to Athens International Airport for the flight to Cairo.
Upon arrival, meet at the airport and transfer to the hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Visit Pyramids and Sphinx
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser, considered the world’s oldest major stone structure. Later, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex, including the Great Pyramids and the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight to Aswan- Nile Cruise
itinerary.text: Breakfast box from the hotel. Transfer to the domestic airport for your flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, transfer to board your 3-night Nile Cruise. Visit the impressive Aswan High Dam and the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise- Visit Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard the cruise. Sail along the Nile to Kom Ombo and visit the fascinating Temple of Kom Ombo, uniquely dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek and Haroeris. After the visit, continue cruising to Edfu. Explore the impressive Temple of Horus, considered one of the best-preserved temples of ancient Egypt with its magnificent columns and detailed carvings. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise - Visit Luxor
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard the cruise. Sail to Esna and continue cruising toward Luxor. Explore the West Bank of the Nile, including the famous Valley of the Kings, burial place of the pharaohs, and the Valley of the Queens. Continue to the impressive Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, one of Egypt’s most remarkable ancient temples. On the way back to the cruise, stop to see the massive Colossi of Memnon. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor to Cairo By flight
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard the cruise, then disembark. Visit the impressive Luxor Temple and the vast Karnak Temple Complex, one of the largest religious sites of ancient Egypt. Later, transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Check out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Explore Greece & Egypt in 11 Days tour?
faqs.a: The Explore Greece & Egypt in 11 Days tour covers Athens, Delphi, and the Saronic Islands in Greece, along with Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, and a Nile Cruise in Egypt. This itinerary combines classical Greek history with the timeless wonders of ancient Egypt, offering a memorable journey through two of the world's most important civilizations. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Explore Greece & Egypt in 11 Days tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,575 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, a Nile Cruise, and three domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, three domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights help maximize sightseeing time and provide convenient travel between destinations in Egypt and Greece. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Greece and Egypt, as well as accommodation aboard a Nile Cruise ship. Daily breakfast is included, along with additional meals according to the itinerary and cruise program.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Egypt. Your guides will provide expert insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of the destinations visited.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines some of the most famous historical sites in Greece with Egypt's legendary monuments and Nile Valley attractions, providing a comprehensive introduction to both countries.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historical landmarks, museums, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the journey.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis and historic monuments of Athens, the UNESCO-listed archaeological site of Delphi, a cruise through the beautiful Saronic Islands, the Pyramids of Giza and Egyptian Museum in Cairo, the Valley of the Kings and Karnak Temple in Luxor, the magnificent temples of Aswan, and a relaxing Nile Cruise through Upper Egypt.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Explore Greece & Egypt in 11 Days tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 60 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 60 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, cruise policies, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Explore Greece & Egypt in 11 Days tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel or cruise categories, include additional destinations, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
